eyebrow: Momcozy · NYC Oct 2026 home shoot, Jordana, Bedminster NJ · 21 Oct 2026 · BM08 creative
title: Stop-motion:
title_short: Jordana · The Sprint to the Crib
headline: The BM08 safety alert goes off and mom turns into an action hero: corner, stairs, hallway, door, crib. Baby is fine.
story: A funny, over-the-top BM08 creative. The brief asks for still-photo stop-motion with motion blur and exaggerated moves. What was shot is video, so we build the look in the edit with a stepped frame rate and blur.

The run is in the footage: hallway, stairs, landing, door, light, bed. The BM08 itself, the red safety-zone alert and the happy ending are not in this folder. Cut the run now and leave clean holes for those inserts.
Loops: L1 “What did the alert see?” opens at 0:00 and closes at the bed. Stakes: her baby climbing the crib rail.
do: Hook text already on screen at 0:00.
Stepped frame rate (8 fps look) on every run shot, plus blur.
Cut on the whip pans and the light coming on.
Big sound design: whoosh, skid, footsteps, light click.
Leave the end on relief, never on fear.
dont: No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No crying. Jamie cries in IMG_9467 from 00:02.5: do not use it.
No held still longer than 4 frames: the step look is fine, a freeze is not.
No heart-rate or breathing claims for the BM08.
Do not show the BM08 at the head or foot of the crib if the insert comes. Either side only.

bp_intro: All clips are vertical iPhone HEVC, 3840×2160 with rotation (plays 2160×3840), 24 fps. Times are mm:ss.s in each clip, read from keyframes pulled this run, good to about 1 s. This video has no spoken lines.

rows.visual: Script: mom holds the BM08, sees the baby asleep, sighs. Then the red safety-zone alert pops up. Not found in the footage. B-roll TBD: a BM08 insert (mom's hands on the monitor, baby on its screen, then the red alert from the app) is needed. Until it lands, open on the next row and put the hook text on it.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1: WHEN THE MONITOR ALERT GOES OFF 😳 Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third, Inter ExtraBold, white with a soft shadow. No logo, no name, no fade.
rows.sfx: Alert ping on the cut to the red screen.
rows.music: Dramatic action-movie sting starts on frame 1.

rows.frame_alt: Jordana at the far end of a narrow white hallway, starting to run toward the camera.
rows.visual: IMG_9464.MOV 00:07.5 to 00:09.6: Jordana runs down the narrow hallway and past the lens. Her hair flies at 00:09.2. Cut on the whip past camera. Stop-motion look: Posterize Time 8 fps (each frame held 3 frames) plus a little directional blur.
rows.motion: Hook text off on the whip.
rows.sfx: Whoosh on the pass, a skid on the turn.

rows.sfx: Quick footstep hits, one per step.

rows.frame_alt: Wide upstairs landing, Jordana sprinting away from camera past the railing.
rows.visual: IMG_9464.MOV 00:09.6 to 00:11.9: she sprints away down the landing past the railing. Big, action-hero energy. Stop-motion look: Posterize Time 8 fps (each frame held 3 frames) plus a little directional blur.

rows.frame_alt: Dark kids' room, the air purifier on a white dresser in the foreground, Jordana bursting through the door, light on.
rows.visual: IMG_9466.MOV 00:19.5 to 00:25.1: the door opens, the light comes on, she rushes in. Start on the dark room, cut on the light. Do not linger on the air purifier in the foreground: it is not the product here.

rows.frame_alt: Jordana from behind at the white toddler bed, Jamie's legs visible.
rows.visual: IMG_9467.MOV 00:00.0 to 00:02.0: she reaches the bed. Out before 00:02.5: Jamie starts to cry. The script end (baby lying safe, smiling, mom's big sigh) is not found in the footage. Hold for that insert.
B-roll TBD: baby safe in the crib, smiling, and mom's sigh of relief. Not found in the footage.

checklist: The hook text is on screen at 0:00 and does not animate on.
No logo before the end card.
Every run shot has the stepped 8 fps look.
No single frame held longer than 4 frames.
No camera audio: music and sound design only.
Any BM08 shot shows the baby on its screen.

decisions.b: No BM08, no red safety-zone alert and no baby-on-screen shot are in this folder. The video cannot tell the story without them. Atdhe: shoot or send the monitor inserts, or say where they are.
The only bed clip (IMG_9467) has Jamie crying. The script end (baby lying safe and smiling, mom's sigh) needs an insert.
The brief asked for still photos. Video was shot. The plan fakes the look with an 8 fps step. Confirm that is fine for Momcozy.

client_note: Why this matters: Momcozy loves mom humor that lands fast. This one is pure entertainment with the BM08 alert as the trigger.
